items.html: And in the correction, they were impregnated with a first Ibur, and the vessels of the VAK, which were all within Ima, were clarified little by little. And every aspect of the vessels that was clarified for the good — and the Mochin entered in them, which are the fetus itself — while what was not clarified of the vessels and remained mixed, good and evil, remained in the belly of Ima.
